//: Phase 6 manual steps (docs/05-build-phases.md): this file is the REAL, committable portion of Firebase config. It does NOT yet work standalone — `firebase deploy` also needs a .firebaserc mapping the `target` names below ('village', 'resort') to real Firebase Hosting site IDs, which only exist once a real Firebase project has been created (`firebase init` / `firebase target:apply`, both requiring live Google Cloud credentials this environment doesn't have). That project creation, the two `firebase hosting:sites:create` calls, and the resulting `.firebaserc` are out of scope here and are on the user's manual checklist. Once that exists, `firebase deploy --only hosting:village` / `hosting:resort` (or the GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows/deploy.yml) will work unmodified against this file.
//csp: CSP allows: 'self' (all first-party JS/CSS/fonts/images — fonts are self-hosted via @fontsource, no external font CDN); script-src also allows googletagmanager.com (GA4's gtag.js) and 'unsafe-inline' (the GA4 bootstrap snippet in src/components/ui/GoogleAnalytics.tsx is a plain inline <script>, not nonce/hash-based — acceptable tradeoff for a static-hosting-only site with no user-generated content and no other inline-script vector); connect-src allows google-analytics.com/googletagmanager.com (gtag's beacon requests) and formspree.io (EnquiryForm.tsx's fetch() POST); img-src allows data: for the base64 LQIP placeholders (src/components/ui/Image.tsx); frame-src allows youtube.com/vimeo.com for src/components/VideoModal.tsx's embeds (component exists, not currently wired into a page, kept forward-compatible). wa.me and Google Maps search links are plain <a href> navigations, not fetch/frame/script loads, so they need no CSP entry — CSP does not restrict top-level link navigation.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://www.google-analytics.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://www.googletagmanager.com https://formspree.io; frame-src https://www.youtube.com https://player.vimeo.com; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://formspree.io; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'
